annotations.title: Read a Verbex guide, template or tool

description: Get the full text of a search result by id, as Markdown. Guides come with a short summary; templates include the blank template, a worked example where there is one, and a link to the editable Word or Excel file. Calculators return the method, the input fields and a worked example computed by the calculator.

id.description: An id from search, e.g. "template:experiment-plan" or "guide:lab-sop-template".
